# Safety Gear

> > Safety Gear is an industrial safety equipment supplier offering ANSI/OSHA-compliant personal protective equipment, high-visibility apparel, workplace signage, and DOT placards.

Safety Gear provides comprehensive safety solutions for construction, transportation, industrial, and municipal workplaces. The catalog features products from leading manufacturers including MSA, OccuNomix, National Marker Corporation, Jackson Safety, Task Gloves, and General Electric, with emphasis on ANSI and OSHA compliance standards.

## Key Topics

- ANSI compliance (Z87.1, Z535, Class E, A2, A4)
- OSHA 1910.145 standards
- DOT placards and transportation safety
- High-visibility (hi-viz) apparel
- Personal protective equipment (PPE)
- Cut-resistant gloves
- Hard hats and head protection
- Safety signage and labels
- Work gloves (nitrile-coated, polyurethane-coated)
- Eye protection and safety glasses
- Respiratory protection
- National Marker Corporation products
- MSA safety equipment
- OccuNomix gear
- Workplace hazard communication
